title: Gain on kill
wikitext:
'''Life gain on kill''', '''mana gain on kill''', and  '''energy shield gain on kill''' is a form of [[recovery]] that instantly restores an amount of [[life]], [[mana]], or [[energy shield]] respectively when the character [[kill]]s an enemy. Regular on-kill gain only affects the character, and is not applied to or checked on other entities, such as [[minions]], [[traps]], [[mines]], or [[totems]].

==Unique items==
===Life on kill===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%life%gain%on_kill%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%life%gain%on_enemy_death%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%recover%life_on_kill%"
|level=1
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Mana on kill===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%mana%gain%on_kill%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%mana%gain%on_enemy_death%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%recover%mana_on_kill%"
|level=1
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Energy shield on kill===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%energy%gain%on_kill%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%energy%gain%on_enemy_death%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%recover%energy_on_kill%"
|level=1
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Gain Benefit on Kill===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%trigger%on_kill%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%trigger%on_enemy_death%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%chance%on_enemy_death%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%chance%on_kill%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%chance%kill%" AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%bow%skill%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%chance%death%" 
|level=1
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant life or mana gain on hit bonuses.

===Life gain on kill===
These passive skills grant additional life gained when the character kills an enemy.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "base_life_gained_on_enemy_death"
}}	

===Mana gain on kill===
These passive skills grant additional mana gained when the character kills an enemy.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "base_mana_gained_on_enemy_death"
}}

==Ascendancy Passive skills==
These [[Ascendancy class]] passive skill are related to gain on kill.

{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%gained_on_enemy_death%"
  OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%recover%on_kill%"
}}
